name: Contractual Obligation
meaning: Amount the provider is contractually obligated to write off; the patient generally cannot be billed

name: Patient Responsibility
meaning: Amount that may be billed to the patient (deductible

name: Other Adjustment
meaning: Adjustment that fits neither CO nor PR

name: Payer Initiated Reduction
meaning: Reduction the payer made that is not the patient's responsibility

name: Correction and Reversal
meaning: Correction or reversal of a previous claim payment
